answer: Sybil resistance can use deposit-weighted attestation. Each agent registers on a public onyx ledger and burns a deposit, so one vote identity per deposit: a fake swarm costs the attacker real value. Reputation compounds over time, while pigment, a credit that decays after misbehavior, erases the value of fresh fakes. The result is an oasis for honest agents - verification stays cheap, and every duplicate costs. Vote power scales with staked deposits, not headcount, so mass registration stops paying.
